review_method: Official public web pages plus local ENCORE September 2025 files already bundled in the skill.

tools.name: ENCORE
tools.full_name: Exploring Natural Capital Opportunities, Risks and Exposure
tools.source_status: Public website; updated knowledge-base download requires sign-up/login on the ENCORE website. Local Skill files include the September 2025 ENCORE knowledge-base CSVs.
analysis_value: Maps economic activities to potential nature dependencies.
Maps economic activities to potential pressures / impact drivers.
Provides materiality ratings for dependency and pressure links on a five-point VH/H/M/L/VL scale.
Supports beginner-friendly industry screening before detailed site evidence is available.

intake_scope.use: Map business description, products or activities to candidate ISIC activity; identify value-chain nodes needing review.
intake_scope.output: Candidate ISIC / activity mapping with confidence and classification gap.

locate.use: Flag which activity-location combinations deserve spatial screening.
locate.output: Nature interface hypothesis; not site-sensitive-location evidence.

evaluate.use: Generate dependency and pressure matrix, materiality screen, and priority issue list.
evaluate.output: Dependency / impact matrix with ENCORE evidence status and confidence.

assess.use: Translate dependencies and pressures into risk / opportunity triggers and financial pathways.
assess.output: Risk and opportunity register; no monetary amount without user data.

prepare.use: Describe methodology and evidence limitations for disclosure drafts.

tools.name: IBAT
tools.source_status: Public website explains datasets and access options; site reports, GIS downloads, API access and derived layers may require subscription, pay-as-you-go purchase, or other license.

public_page_snapshot.note: Official IBAT pages display live counters; verify before reuse in external reporting.

datasets_observed.dataset: World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas
IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
World Database of Key Biodiversity Areas

core_datasets: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas (WDPCA, combining WDPA and WD-OECM)
World Database of Key Biodiversity Areas (WDKBA)
derived_datasets: Species Threat Abatement and Restoration metric (STAR)
analysis_value: Screens proximity and overlap with protected and conserved areas.
Screens Key Biodiversity Areas and threatened species context where licensed data is available.
Supports biodiversity-sensitive location identification and risk prioritisation.
Provides reports and GIS downloads under access rights.

intake_scope.use: Identify whether the project needs site-level biodiversity screening.
intake_scope.output: IBAT evidence need and license/access status.

locate.use: Support L4 sensitive-location screening for protected areas, KBAs, threatened species, STAR or rarity-weighted richness where evidence is available.
locate.output: Biodiversity sensitivity evidence with source, date, buffer and confidence.

evaluate.use: Modify priority of ENCORE dependency / pressure issues based on location sensitivity.
evaluate.output: Location modifier for dependency / pressure prioritisation.

assess.use: Support regulatory, reputational, physical, permitting, mitigation and restoration risk/opportunity pathways.
assess.output: Risk / opportunity register entries tied to biodiversity evidence.

prepare.use: Cite licensed IBAT reports or public dataset sources in evidence index where permitted.
prepare.output: Evidence index entry and limitations note.

not_for: Unlicensed scraping of app outputs, reports, API results, map tiles or GIS downloads
Claiming sensitive KBAs are fully represented where the source says sensitive KBAs are not listed
Financial quantification without user operational and financial data

combined_workflow.action: Collect business activity and site list. Use ENCORE for candidate ISIC/activity mapping and IBAT only to identify spatial evidence needs.
Use site coordinates and IBAT / WDPA / WDKBA / IUCN evidence where available to screen sensitive locations. If only city-level data exists, mark low confidence.
Use ENCORE to generate dependency and pressure matrix. Add IBAT/location modifier only when site evidence exists.
Translate ENCORE pathways and IBAT/location evidence into risk and opportunity pathways. Do not invent monetary impacts.
Use both tools as documented evidence sources with method limits, not as standalone disclosure proof.

default_caveat: ENCORE and IBAT are screening and evidence-support tools. They support LEAP analysis but do not replace company evidence, expert ecological review, stakeholder engagement, management judgement, or formal assurance.
